svg.title: A matrix is a picture of what it does
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “A matrix is a picture of what it does” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A whiteboard sketch showing four unit squares transformed by a scale, a shear, a forty-five degree rotation and a rank-deficient squash that collapses the square onto a single red line, each with the image of the basis vectors drawn as a blue and a green arrow and the determinant written beneath; the determinant shown as the area of the transformed square going from one to four to zero; the three equivalent readings of a matrix product listed with numbered badges; a shape-check ladder where the inner dimensions of a batched matmul are ringed and joined; and a log-scaled bar chart of matmul throughput from 0.013 GFLOP per second for naive Python loops to 1550 for single-precision BLAS.
svg.text: A matrix is a picture of what it does
draw it from memory, then compare
